independence_declaration.statement: domain-reviewer authored none of the DG7 candidate: no implementation, test, ADR or amendment, handover text, register row, release tool, drill, decision (D-242 to D-284) or stages.json change. My verdict comes from my own runs in this session on the frozen tree (read-only) and a disposable sparse clone of source_commit 3e8f5bce under $TMPDIR (removed afterwards), with disposable PostgreSQL clusters. I did not open any other reviewer's round-3 record or evidence. I read my role's own round-2 record and findings sidecar (as the reporter of F-DG7-1031/1032) and the DO-D12, DO-D13, SA-ADR72 and AN-P7J handbacks.

':!docs/delivery'
checks_run.expected: Assignment hash 3aa82f76…; candidate sha256:cf1fb7d5…; --diff matches; HEAD differs from source_commit only by excluded freeze metadata.
checks_run.actual: Assignment hash matches. candidate_id sha256:cf1fb7d59a04e2f0d18a7773eca4e10893b72f3119a70d0e74796c8a8437a541, exit 0; --diff 'matches: true', no added/removed/changed file, exit 0. The tool reports 3160 files on the working tree versus the assignment's 3158; the difference is the untracked run-metadata directories of the three concurrent round-3 runs (docs/delivery/runs/DG7/…), which do not change the id or the diff. HEAD is 557a95133, one commit after 3e8f5bce ('freeze sha256:cf1fb7d5, assignments, REVIEWING'), touching only the three round-3 assignments, the manifest and stages.json, all excluded from the candidate; I record this rather than BLOCK because the recomputed candidate id, the binding identity, matches. Between ebe11c378 (the rg3b drill's HEAD) and 3e8f5bce only known-limitations.md, release-notes.md and secret-allowlist.json changed outside docs/delivery. Assignment contradiction recorded: it asks for 'round: 7', but the directory and the validator (tools/gates/lib/rules.mjs l.682/l.794: rec.round must equal the round directory) require 3, so this record says 3. I did not run candidate.mjs on a complete clone: the first full clone failed with 'No space left on device' on the shared scratch volume and was deleted; the sparse clone I used (without handbacks, test-evidence and runs) cannot reproduce the id, so the working-tree recomputation plus --diff is the evidence.

checks_run.command: for s in DG1..DG6: node tools/gates/validate.mjs --historical --stage $s; node tools/gates/validate.mjs --register DG7; node tools/gates/validate.mjs --stage DG7; git diff 152db5b51 3e8f5bce -- tools/gates/
checks_run.expected: DG1-DG6 historical PASS; register PASS; --stage DG7 fails only on the not-yet-written gate record; the import change is sound.
checks_run.actual: PASS gate DG1..DG6 (historical), each exit 0. 'PASS register rules at DG7', exit 0. --stage DG7: 'FAIL gate DG7 (current) (1 problem) - gate DG7: file not found (docs/delivery/gates/DG7.json)', exit 1: expected before the audit, no other problem. I also started 'validate.mjs --pipeline' but stopped it with my own 600 s timeout (exit 124); it did not complete, so I count no result for it. import-findings.mjs: the only change maps a FAIL verification whose status_after is 'REOPENED' to status OPEN (the findings schema has no REOPENED); every other value passes through as before, so a FAIL can never close a finding through this path, and the history entry records the actual status. Sound. The id pattern ^F-DG[0-7]-[0-9]{3,4}$ (D-282) keeps every existing id valid; my new id F-DG7-1061 uses it.

checks_run.actual: rg3 (source bf5bf82a): C0-C2 PASS, C3 FAIL exit 1 ('backup: set rg3 failed: the Compose file //deploy/compose/compose.yaml does not exist'), C4-C10 NOT_RUN because of C3, C11 cleanup PASS, drill exit 1: explained by the shallow script mount and repaired by DO-D13. rg3b (HEAD ebe11c378, image rebuilt, deploy and app code identical to the candidate): C0-C11 PASS, drill exit 0, restore R1 6 files 0 mismatches, R2 migration 0152, /readyz {database ok, migrations ok, storage ok, worker alive}, synthetic data, 0 evidence objects. Lines I had to explain: build log 'UnplacedFieldErrors-…js' and 'FailuresPage-…js' are asset names; Vite's chunk-size advisory; 'Lockfile is up to date, resolution step is skipped' is pnpm info; Docker's lint warning SecretsUsedInArgOrEnv on ENV AUTH_MODE (a mode name 'oidc', not a secret). One line is NOT explained anywhere: rg3b 02-compose-backup-drill.log l.257 / finish.out 'cat: /tmp/mth-backup.hBaAOK/config.sha: No such file or directory' in the finish phase. I traced it to a product defect (DOM-RG3-04) and raised F-DG7-1061. The drill's overall PASS is the orchestrator's and its R1-R10 steps are sound apart from that; I do not mark the drill PASS myself.

checks_run.procedure: Run deploy/scripts/tests/backup-restore.test.mjs unmodified (T-E1..T-E13) and the layout tests; then, in the clone only, add a probe to T-E1 and T-E11 that prints the manifest's config section and asserts config.files is non-empty for the split-phase (Compose) sequence.
checks_run.command: (clone at 3e8f5bce) QA_PG_PORT=32330 tests/qa/support/with-pg.sh node --test deploy/scripts/tests/backup-restore.test.mjs; npx vitest run --configLoader runner deploy/scripts/tests/backup-compose-layout.vitest.mjs; (probe) QA_PG_PORT=32310/32320 tests/qa/support/with-pg.sh node --test deploy/scripts/tests/backup-restore.test.mjs with probe-t-e11-config-files.diff applied
checks_run.environment: disposable sparse clone under $TMPDIR (node_modules linked read-only), disposable PostgreSQL 16 cluster, Node 24.21.0
checks_run.expected: Unmodified suites pass; the split-phase manifest lists the config/ files as ADR-0066 §2 and backup-restore.md §2 require.
checks_run.actual: Unmodified: 18 tests, 18 pass, 0 fail, 0 skipped, exit 0 (T-E10 owner-only, T-E11 split phase, T-E12 shared root refused, T-E13a-d symbolic-link root judged by target). Layout: 12/12 passed, exit 0. Probe runs: exit 1 by design, 17 pass, 1 fail; the one failing assertion is my probe 'split-phase manifest config.files is empty' in T-E11. T-E1 (--phase all) prints config.files = compose.yaml, environment.env, images.lock.json with SHA-256; T-E11 (database then finish) prints config {files: [], sha256: 3a7ce9a2…} and fin.out holds 'cat: …/mth-backup.<x>/config.sha: No such file or directory'. Cause: backup.sh writes the listing to the per-process $WORK (l.446) and the finish phase reads it from its own new $WORK (l.585). This is F-DG7-1061 (Medium). The config files remain hashed in the manifest's 'files' array, so restore integrity (R1) is unaffected.

summary: FAIL on one new Medium finding. Candidate verified (sha256:cf1fb7d5…; HEAD differs only by freeze metadata); DG1-DG6 historical and register validation PASS. F-DG7-1031 and F-DG7-1032 verified CLOSED_VERIFIED: the Compose half of A19 was run on the orchestrator's host, failed at C3, was repaired by DO-D13 and passed C0-C11 on this candidate's code; ADR-0063/0066 amended as built. The product behaves as required elsewhere: register/About equal the CSV in Arabic RTL and English LTR (16/16), P7 integration 89/89, backup scripts 18/18, layout tests 12/12, and the secret, claims, release-notes and handover checks PASS. New: F-DG7-1061 (Medium, REQ-S19-012). The orchestrator's PASS drill log contains an unexplained 'cat: …/config.sha: No such file or directory'. I traced it to backup.sh: in the documented Compose (split-phase) sequence the manifest's config.files is always empty, and I reproduced this with a probe on a disposable PostgreSQL. Medium findings must be repaired before the gate (D-192), so the verdict is FAIL. This review grants no business, Finance, IT or production approval and implies neither DG7 nor any G1-G6 approval.
